sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 240. Success value 100. 2x physical damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Removes debuffs.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical and magic damage taken by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Prosperity (continuous buff that renews the effect "increases all stats by 20% for 60 seconds" every 10 seconds) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 20 Cost.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 6000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 6000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all enemies. Activates time slice which reduces the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 20 seconds.
Only [Rabbit Prankster] Osto can be used as Unlocking Potential material
